name: z-image
description: z-image is a vision benchmark that evaluates models' image understanding capabilities in zero-shot and few-shot settings. It measures performance on tasks such as image classification, captioning, and visual question answering across a diverse set of images. The benchmark emphasizes generalization to unseen categories and robustness to visual variation.
reputation: Emerging benchmark with modest community adoption, commonly used in Hugging Face docs-benchmarks for comparing visual model capabilities.
